ExtePlayer3 Android experimental PTS core — source attribution

Upstream project: https://github.com/skyjet18/exteplayer3
Vendored source: include/pts_clock.h (from upstream branch master)
License: GPL-2.0-or-later (upstream original ExtePlayer3 sources).
GPL-2.0 text is bundled in this assets directory.

The Android experiment COMPILES the authentic upstream pts_clock.h and
adapts its 90kHz MPEG-TS PTS corrections into the JNI software decoder.
The upstream Enigma2 LinuxDVB output/driver and complete movie player
are NOT shipped and are NOT claimed to be Android compatible.
A further full player port requires replacing its LinuxDVB writer and
other receiver-specific runtime dependencies.

Project repository and corresponding integration source:
https://github.com/mostafaaqeel484-dot/IRAQhub
FFmpeg 9.0.2 is separately sourced and LGPL shared-linked. See
assets/third_party/ffmpeg/LICENSE.md for original FFmpeg notices.
